notes:
### App — Help Viewer + Settings Sidebar — 2026-06-08

- **fix: In-app help viewer** — three separate breakages resolved: (1) `navigate('help')` had no handler in the switch chain; (2) `help.js` was not included as a `<script>` tag in `dashboard.html`; (3) `web/routes/help.py` blueprint was never imported or registered in `server.py`, so every `/api/help` call returned 404. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`, `web/server.py`)
- **feat: Help viewer CSS** — complete set of `help-*` styles added: two-pane layout (`help-wrap`, `help-sidebar`, `help-pane`), sidebar nav items with active/hover states, search input, guide header, section headings, paragraph/bullet/code-block formatting, and search highlight mark. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: Settings sidebar vertical scrollbar** — `.set-layout` changed from `min-height` to `height` (constrains layout to viewport); `overflow-y: auto` added to `.set-nav` so the sidebar scrolls when its content is taller than the window. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **docs: Guide content updates** — dashboard KPI section corrected to 3-card row (Bank / Projected / ATO-BAS obligations) matching actual UI; Reports guide extended with EOY Accountant Package and COA Mapping sections; Recurring guide rewritten to cover Invoice, Bill, and Journal template types with multi-line item detail; Contacts guide gains Work Tasks section (recurring tasks, schedule-next modal, invoice-from-tasks). (`tools/build_guides.py`)
- **chore: `help_content.json` regenerated** — 25 guides rebuilt from updated `build_guides.py` content. (`web/static/help_content.json`)

### App — Recurring Transactions — Multi-Line Support — 2026-06-08

- **feat: Multi-line recurring templates** — Invoice and Bill templates now use a line-item table (Description / Qty / Unit Price / Tax / Account) instead of single Amount + Account fields. Journal templates use a double-entry lines table (Account / Debit / Credit / Memo) with running debit/credit totals and an out-of-balance warning. All three types validated before save: Journal requires ≥2 balanced lines with accounts selected; Invoice/Bill requires at least one line with a price. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **feat: Backward-compatible single-line migration** — existing templates without `lines_json` are auto-converted to a single-line when editing (amount → unit_price for Invoice/Bill; amount → debit for Journal). Saves immediately migrate to `lines_json` format. Engine was already multi-line capable; only the UI needed updating. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **feat: Lines displayed in template detail panel** — detail view shows a full read-only line items table when `lines_json` is present, with account names resolved server-side. Amount summary label adapts: "Total Dr/Cr" for Journal, "Total (excl. GST)" for Invoice/Bill. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **feat: Type-change line reset** — switching between Journal and Invoice/Bill families in the edit form resets the lines array to one default line; switching between Invoice and Bill preserves existing lines. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **backend: `save_template` auto-serializes `lines_json`** — if client sends a Python list, it is JSON-serialised before writing to SQLite so `json.loads()` in the engine always succeeds. (`core/recurring.py`)
- **backend: `GET /api/recurring/<id>` enriched** — parses `lines_json` from JSON string to array before returning; joins `accounts` table to add `account_name` to each line. (`web/routes/jobs.py`)
- **css: `rec-lines-tbl` and related classes** — compact line-item table for use inside the det-panel slide-over; `rec-line-del` delete button; `rec-balance-warn` out-of-balance indicator; `rec-lines-detail` detail-view section. (`web/static/dbox.css`)

### App — Update Banner — 2026-06-07

- **feat: Release notes rendered as formatted text** — added `_renderMarkdown()` helper that escapes HTML then converts `### headings`, `- bullets`, `**bold**`, and `` `code` `` spans to HTML. Previously showed raw markdown syntax. XSS-safe: HTML escaping runs before inline transforms. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **fix: Release notes modal close button invisible** — header button used `class="modal-x"` which has no CSS; changed to `modal-close` (the standard header close class used across all other modals). (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **fix: Release notes modal body not scrolling** — `modal-box` was not a flex column so `flex:1` on `modal-body` had no effect; `max-height:60vh` on the body fought the box's own `padding:26px` with no outer height constraint. Added `display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-height:90vh` to the box, removed the inline `max-height` from the body, added `min-height:0` for reliable flex scroll. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)

### Build — 2026-06-07

- **fix: build_dist.py subprocess encoding on Windows** — `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` used the system default cp1252 encoding, mangling UTF-8 characters (em dashes, checkmarks) in git commit messages and stderr output. Added `encoding='utf-8'` to all three `subprocess.run` calls in `build_dist.py` (tag creation, `git()` helper, tag push). (`tools/build_dist.py`)
